description.value: Bearfoot Bistro is one of British Columbia's most acclaimed fine dining restaurants, operating in Whistler's village core for over 30 years and serving innovative modern Canadian cuisine with ingredients sourced from producers coast to coast. The restaurant is known for its signature champagne sabering tableside, a Grey Goose Vodka Ice Room, and an underground wine cellar that hosts private dinners for groups up to 400 guests. Located inside the Listel Whistler hotel building, it is a destination evening restaurant that a touring cyclist might seek out for a celebratory meal after a long ride.

raw_osm.name: Bearfoot Bistro
raw_osm.wheelchair:description: Must use internal ramp located just to the north of the entrance to the Listel Hotel to bring you into the lobby of the hotel, which then has an entrance into the lounge of Bearfoot Bistro.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Bearfoot Bistro is an active, upscale fine dining restaurant in Whistler village core, co-located with the Listel Whistler hotel, and describes itself as one of BC's most acclaimed restaurants for over 30 years. The Spring 2026 prix fixe menu explicitly lists 'Glazed Maitake Mushroom vegan' as a main course, confirming a vegan option. No bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere in the website content; the OSM tags toilets:wheelchair=yes and wheelchair:description confirm accessible on-site washrooms.
